title: MatPlotAgent: Method and Evaluation for LLM-Based Agentic Scientific Data Visualization

layout.note: Top row: Raw Data (left) and User Query (right), each a dashed frame with a coloured tab title and the four cases in a 2 x 2 arrangement. Bottom row: one wide indigo dashed frame, Output Figure, with the four plots side by side. The same four letter chips sit in each band.

lesson: Show benchmark cases as bands by content kind (data, query, expected output) and repeat the same colour-coded letter chip in each band, so every case can be followed across the bands without arrows; crop tables and queries and say so in the caption.
